Its member list is then regenerated redundantly\n//    on every rank on the CPU using OpenMP, so no member data needs to be\n//    communicated.\n//  - Device code is compiled with -fmad=false and host code with\n//    -ffp-contract=off so CPU and GPU distances are bit-identical and the\n//    result matches the sequential algorithm exactly.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                            \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                       \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Sentinel marking a point that is already a member of the growing cluster\n// (or otherwise ineligible). Always >= any real distance and any threshold.\nstatic const double EXCLUDED = DBL_MAX;\n\nstatic const int TPB = 256;       // threads per block\nstatic const int MAX_GRID = 512;  // max concurrent candidate clusters per GPU\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. Points are the compacted\n// (unclustered-only) set; coordinates in ux/uy. Block k handles compact seed\n// index firstSeed + k*seedStride (round-robin MPI distribution), grid-striding\n// over the rank's seeds. dist[j] tracks the max distance from point j to all\n// current cluster members; each step adds the point with minimal dist[j]\n// subject to dist[j] < threshold (ties -> lowest index), matching the\n// sequential algorithm. Only the resulting cardinality is stored.\n__global__ void candidateClusterKernel(const double* __restrict__ ux,\n                                       const double* __restrict__ uy,\n                                       const int U,\n                                       const double threshold,\n                                       const int firstSeed,\n                                       const int seedStride,\n                                       const int numLocalSeeds,\n                                       double* __restrict__ work,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ double bestX, bestY;\n\n    double* dist = work + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * U;\n\n    for (int k = blockIdx.x; k < numLocalSeeds; k += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = firstSeed + k * seedStride;\n        const double sx = ux[seed];\n        const double sy = uy[seed];\n\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n            if (j == seed) {\n                dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n            } else {\n                const double dx = ux[j] - sx;\n                const double dy = uy[j] - sy;\n                dist[j] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        int count = 1;\n        while (count < U) {\n            // Block-wide argmin over eligible candidates\n            double bd = DBL_MAX;\n            int bi = INT_MAX;\n            for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d < threshold && d < bd) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = j;\n                }\n            }\n            sdist[threadIdx.x] = bd;\n            sidx[threadIdx.x] = bi;\n            __syncthreads();\n            for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n                if (threadIdx.x < s) {\n                    const double od = sdist[threadIdx.x + s];\n                    const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + s];\n                    if (od < sdist[threadIdx.x] ||\n                        (od == sdist[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                        sdist[threadIdx.x] = od;\n                        sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                    }\n                }\n                __syncthreads();\n            }\n\n            const int best = sidx[0];\n            if (best == INT_MAX) break;  // no candidate keeps diameter < threshold\n\n            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n                bestX = ux[best];\n                bestY = uy[best];\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            // Fold the new member's distances into the running maxima\n            for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n                if (j == best) {\n                    dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d != EXCLUDED) {\n                    const double dx = ux[j] - bestX;\n                    const double dy = uy[j] - bestY;\n                    const double nd = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                    if (nd > d) dist[j] = nd;\n                }\n            }\n            ++count;\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            cards[k] = count;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Regenerate the winning cluster on the CPU (OpenMP-parallel greedy growth\n// over the compacted point set). Same selection rules as the CUDA kernel and\n// the original sequential code; returns members as original point indices.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const std::vector<double>& ux,\n                                        const std::vector<double>& uy,\n                                        const std::vector<int>& orig,\n                                        const int U,\n                                        const int seed,\n                                        const double threshold) {\n    std::vector<double> dist(U);\n    const double sx = ux[seed];\n    const double sy = uy[seed];\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n        if (j == seed) {\n            dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n        } else {\n            const double dx = ux[j] - sx;\n            const double dy = uy[j] - sy;\n            dist[j] = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.push_back(orig[seed]);\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < U) {\n        double bd = DBL_MAX;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            double lbd = DBL_MAX;\n            int lbi = INT_MAX;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d < threshold && d < lbd) {\n                    lbd = d;\n                    lbi = j;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lbd < bd || (lbd == bd && lbi < bi)) {\n                    bd = lbd;\n                    bi = lbi;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;\n\n        const double bx = ux[bi];\n        const double by = uy[bi];\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n            if (j == bi) {\n                dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n                continue;\n            }\n            const double d = dist[j];\n            if (d != EXCLUDED) {\n                const double dx = ux[j] - bx;\n                const double dy = uy[j] - by;\n                const double nd = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                if (nd > d) dist[j] = nd;\n            }\n        }\n\n        members.push_back(orig[bi]);\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int nprocs) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Compacted unclustered point set (rebuilt each round, ascending order)\n    std::vector<double> ux(N), uy(N);\n    std::vector<int> orig(N);\n\n    // Device buffers sized once for the worst case\n    double *d_ux = nullptr, *d_uy = nullptr, *d_work = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = nullptr;\n    const int maxLocalSeeds = (N + nprocs - 1) / nprocs;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ux, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_uy, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_work, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(MAX_GRID) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_cards, sizeof(int) * std::max(maxLocalSeeds, 1)));\n    std::vector<int> h_cards(std::max(maxLocalSeeds, 1));\n\n    int remaining = N;\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // Compact the unclustered points (ascending original index)\n        int U = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            if (!clustered[i]) {\n                ux[U] = points[i].x;\n                uy[U] = points[i].y;\n                orig[U] = i;\n                ++U;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // This rank evaluates compact seeds rank, rank+nprocs, ...\n        const int numLocalSeeds = (rank < U) ? (U - rank + nprocs - 1) / nprocs : 0;\n\n        // Local best: max cardinality, ties -> lowest original seed index.\n        // Encoded as (cardinality, seed index) for MPI_MAXLOC, which picks the\n        // max value and the minimum index on ties - exactly the order in which\n        // the sequential code scans seeds.\n        int localBest[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};\n\n        if (numLocalSeeds > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_ux, ux.data(), sizeof(double) * U,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_uy, uy.data(), sizeof(double) * U,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n            const int grid = std::min(MAX_GRID, numLocalSeeds);\n            candidateClusterKernel<<<grid, TPB>>>(d_ux, d_uy, U, threshold,\n                                                  rank, nprocs, numLocalSeeds,\n                                                  d_work, d_cards);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_cards.data(), d_cards,\n                                  sizeof(int) * numLocalSeeds,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            // Compact seed indices are ascending, so the first maximum is the\n            // one with the lowest original seed index.\n            for (int k = 0; k < numLocalSeeds; ++k) {\n                if (h_cards[k] > localBest[0]) {\n                    localBest[0] = h_cards[k];\n                    localBest[1] = orig[rank + k * nprocs];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        int globalBest[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(localBest, globalBest, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (globalBest[0] <= 0) break;  // no more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Regenerate the winning cluster on every rank (deterministic)\n        const int bestSeed = globalBest[1];\n        const int compactSeed = static_cast<int>(\n            std::lower_bound(orig.begin(), orig.begin() + U, bestSeed) -\n            orig.begin());\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = bestSeed;\n        cluster.members = growClusterHost(ux, uy, orig, U, compactSeed, threshold);\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[cluster.members[i]] = true;\n        }\n        remaining -= static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size());\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_ux));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_uy));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_work));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_cards));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        #pragma omp parallel for reduction(max:max_diameter) schedule(dynamic)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    // Bind one GPU per rank (round-robin over the node's devices)\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount < 1) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Error: no CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(rank % deviceCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));  // establish context before timing\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, GPUs/node: %d, OpenMP threads: %d\\n\",\n               nprocs, deviceCount, omp_get_max_threads());\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, nprocs);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n        // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n        int total_clustered = 0;\n        int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n            const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n            total_clustered += size;\n            max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n        }\n\n        const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n            static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n        const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\",\n               clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n            std::vector<double> membershipData;\n            membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n            std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n            for (size_t c = 0; Its member list is then regenerated redundantly\n//    on every rank on the CPU using OpenMP, so no member data needs to be\n//    communicated.\n//  - Device code is compiled with -fmad=false and host code with\n//    -ffp-contract=off so CPU and GPU distances are bit-identical and the\n//    result matches the sequential algorithm exactly.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                            \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                       \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Sentinel marking a point that is already a member of the growing cluster\n// (or otherwise ineligible). Always >= any real distance and any threshold.\nstatic const double EXCLUDED = DBL_MAX;\n\nstatic const int TPB = 256;       // threads per block\nstatic const int MAX_GRID = 512;  // max concurrent candidate clusters per GPU\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. Points are the compacted\n// (unclustered-only) set; coordinates in ux/uy. Block k handles compact seed\n// index firstSeed + k*seedStride (round-robin MPI distribution), grid-striding\n// over the rank's seeds. dist[j] tracks the max distance from point j to all\n// current cluster members; each step adds the point with minimal dist[j]\n// subject to dist[j] < threshold (ties -> lowest index), matching the\n// sequential algorithm. Only the resulting cardinality is stored.\n__global__ void candidateClusterKernel(const double* __restrict__ ux,\n                                       const double* __restrict__ uy,\n                                       const int U,\n                                       const double threshold,\n                                       const int firstSeed,\n                                       const int seedStride,\n                                       const int numLocalSeeds,\n                                       double* __restrict__ work,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ double bestX, bestY;\n\n    double* dist = work + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * U;\n\n    for (int k = blockIdx.x; k < numLocalSeeds; k += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = firstSeed + k * seedStride;\n        const double sx = ux[seed];\n        const double sy = uy[seed];\n\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n            if (j == seed) {\n                dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n            } else {\n                const double dx = ux[j] - sx;\n                const double dy = uy[j] - sy;\n                dist[j] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        int count = 1;\n        while (count < U) {\n            // Block-wide argmin over eligible candidates\n            double bd = DBL_MAX;\n            int bi = INT_MAX;\n            for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d < threshold && d < bd) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = j;\n                }\n            }\n            sdist[threadIdx.x] = bd;\n            sidx[threadIdx.x] = bi;\n            __syncthreads();\n            for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n                if (threadIdx.x < s) {\n                    const double od = sdist[threadIdx.x + s];\n                    const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + s];\n                    if (od < sdist[threadIdx.x] ||\n                        (od == sdist[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                        sdist[threadIdx.x] = od;\n                        sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                    }\n                }\n                __syncthreads();\n            }\n\n            const int best = sidx[0];\n            if (best == INT_MAX) break;  // no candidate keeps diameter < threshold\n\n            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n                bestX = ux[best];\n                bestY = uy[best];\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            // Fold the new member's distances into the running maxima\n            for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n                if (j == best) {\n                    dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d != EXCLUDED) {\n                    const double dx = ux[j] - bestX;\n                    const double dy = uy[j] - bestY;\n                    const double nd = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                    if (nd > d) dist[j] = nd;\n                }\n            }\n            ++count;\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            cards[k] = count;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Regenerate the winning cluster on the CPU (OpenMP-parallel greedy growth\n// over the compacted point set). Same selection rules as the CUDA kernel and\n// the original sequential code; returns members as original point indices.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const std::vector<double>& ux,\n                                        const std::vector<double>& uy,\n                                        const std::vector<int>& orig,\n                                        const int U,\n                                        const int seed,\n                                        const double threshold) {\n    std::vector<double> dist(U);\n    const double sx = ux[seed];\n    const double sy = uy[seed];\n\n    // For small working sets the OpenMP fork/join overhead per growth step\n    // outweighs the parallel work; run those serially.\n    const bool par = U >= 4096;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if(par)\n    for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n        if (j == seed) {\n            dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n        } else {\n            const double dx = ux[j] - sx;\n            const double dy = uy[j] - sy;\n            dist[j] = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.push_back(orig[seed]);\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < U) {\n        double bd = DBL_MAX;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            double lbd = DBL_MAX;\n            int lbi = INT_MAX;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d < threshold && d < lbd) {\n                    lbd = d;\n                    lbi = j;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lbd < bd || (lbd == bd && lbi < bi)) {\n                    bd = lbd;\n                    bi = lbi;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;\n\n        const double bx = ux[bi];\n        const double by = uy[bi];\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n            if (j == bi) {\n                dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n                continue;\n            }\n            const double d = dist[j];\n            if (d != EXCLUDED) {\n                const double dx = ux[j] - bx;\n                const double dy = uy[j] - by;\n                const double nd = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                if (nd > d) dist[j] = nd;\n            }\n        }\n\n        members.push_back(orig[bi]);\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int nprocs) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Compacted unclustered point set (rebuilt each round, ascending order)\n    std::vector<double> ux(N), uy(N);\n    std::vector<int> orig(N);\n\n    // Device buffers sized once for the worst case\n    double *d_ux = nullptr, *d_uy = nullptr, *d_work = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = nullptr;\n    const int maxLocalSeeds = (N + nprocs - 1) / nprocs;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ux, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_uy, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_work, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(MAX_GRID) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_cards, sizeof(int) * std::max(maxLocalSeeds, 1)));\n    std::vector<int> h_cards(std::max(maxLocalSeeds, 1));\n\n    int remaining = N;\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // Compact the unclustered points (ascending original index)\n        int U = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            if (!clustered[i]) {\n                ux[U] = points[i].x;\n                uy[U] = points[i].y;\n                orig[U] = i;\n                ++U;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // This rank evaluates compact seeds rank, rank+nprocs, ...\n        const int numLocalSeeds = (rank < U) ? (U - rank + nprocs - 1) / nprocs : 0;\n\n        // Local best: max cardinality, ties -> lowest original seed index.\n        // Encoded as (cardinality, seed index) for MPI_MAXLOC, which picks the\n        // max value and the minimum index on ties - exactly the order in which\n        // the sequential code scans seeds.\n        int localBest[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};\n\n        if (numLocalSeeds > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_ux, ux.data(), sizeof(double) * U,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_uy, uy.data(), sizeof(double) * U,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n            const int grid = std::min(MAX_GRID, numLocalSeeds);\n            candidateClusterKernel<<<grid, TPB>>>(d_ux, d_uy, U, threshold,\n                                                  rank, nprocs, numLocalSeeds,\n                                                  d_work, d_cards);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_cards.data(), d_cards,\n                                  sizeof(int) * numLocalSeeds,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            // Compact seed indices are ascending, so the first maximum is the\n            // one with the lowest original seed index.\n            for (int k = 0; k < numLocalSeeds; ++k) {\n                if (h_cards[k] > localBest[0]) {\n                    localBest[0] = h_cards[k];\n                    localBest[1] = orig[rank + k * nprocs];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        int globalBest[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(localBest, globalBest, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (globalBest[0] <= 0) break;  // no more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Regenerate the winning cluster on every rank (deterministic)\n        const int bestSeed = globalBest[1];\n        const int compactSeed = static_cast<int>(\n            std::lower_bound(orig.begin(), orig.begin() + U, bestSeed) -\n            orig.begin());\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = bestSeed;\n        cluster.members = growClusterHost(ux, uy, orig, U, compactSeed, threshold);\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[cluster.members[i]] = true;\n        }\n        remaining -= static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size());\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_ux));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_uy));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_work));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_cards));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; Its member list is then regenerated redundantly\n//    on every rank on the CPU using OpenMP, so no member data needs to be\n//    communicated.\n//  - Device code is compiled with -fmad=false and host code with\n//    -ffp-contract=off so CPU and GPU distances are bit-identical and the\n//    result matches the sequential algorithm exactly.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Sentinel marking a point that is already a member of the growing cluster\n// (or otherwise ineligible). Always >= any real distance and any threshold.\nstatic const double EXCLUDED = DBL_MAX;\n\nstatic const int TPB = 256;       // threads per block\nstatic const int MAX_GRID = 512;  // max concurrent candidate clusters per GPU\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. Points are the compacted\n// (unclustered-only) set; coordinates in ux/uy. Only the resulting cardinality is stored.\n__global__ void candidateClusterKernel(const double* __restrict__ ux,\n                                       const double* __restrict__ uy,\n                                       const int U,\n                                       const double threshold,\n                                       const int firstSeed,\n                                       const int seedStride,\n                                       const int numLocalSeeds,\n                                       double* __restrict__ work,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ double bestX, bestY;\n\n    double* dist = work + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * U;\n\n    for (int k = blockIdx.x; Same selection rules as the CUDA kernel and\n// the original sequential code; returns members as original point indices.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const std::vector<double>& ux,\n                                        const std::vector<double>& uy,\n                                        const std::vector<int>& orig,\n                                        const int U,\n                                        const int seed,\n                                        const double threshold) {\n    std::vector<double> dist(U);\n    const double sx = ux[seed];\n    const double sy = uy[seed];\n\n    // For small working sets the OpenMP fork/join overhead per growth step\n    // outweighs the parallel work; j < U; ++j) {\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d < threshold && d < lbd) {\n                    lbd = d;\n                    lbi = j;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lbd < bd || (lbd == bd && lbi < bi)) {\n                    bd = lbd;\n                    bi = lbi;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;\n\n        const double bx = ux[bi];\n        const double by = uy[bi];\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n            if (j == bi) {\n                dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n                continue;\n            }\n            const double d = dist[j];\n            if (d != EXCLUDED) {\n                const double dx = ux[j] - bx;\n                const double dy = uy[j] - by;\n                const double nd = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                if (nd > d) dist[j] = nd;\n            }\n        }\n\n        members.push_back(orig[bi]);\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int nprocs) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Compacted unclustered point set (rebuilt each round, ascending order)\n    std::vector<double> ux(N), uy(N);\n    std::vector<int> orig(N);\n\n    // Device buffers sized once for the worst case\n    double *d_ux = nullptr, *d_uy = nullptr, *d_work = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = nullptr;\n    const int maxLocalSeeds = (N + nprocs - 1) / nprocs;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ux, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_uy, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_work, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(MAX_GRID) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_cards, sizeof(int) * std::max(maxLocalSeeds, 1)));\n    std::vector<int> h_cards(std::max(maxLocalSeeds, 1));\n\n    int remaining = N;\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // Compact the unclustered points (ascending original index)\n        int U = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            if (!clustered[i]) {\n                ux[U] = points[i].x;\n                uy[U] = points[i].y;\n                orig[U] = i;\n                ++U;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // This rank evaluates compact seeds rank, rank+nprocs, ...\n        const int numLocalSeeds = (rank < U) ? k < numLocalSeeds; ++k) {\n                if (h_cards[k] > localBest[0]) {\n                    localBest[0] = h_cards[k];\n                    localBest[1] = orig[rank + k * nprocs];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        int globalBest[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(localBest, globalBest, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (globalBest[0] <= 0) break; otherwise every rank spawns nproc threads and\n    // the node is heavily oversubscribed.\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank,\n                        MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n    if (getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\") == nullptr) {\n        omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, omp_get_num_procs() / localSize));\n    }","originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//  - Each round, every unclustered point is evaluated as a candidate seed.\n//    Seeds are distributed round-robin across MPI ranks (one GPU per rank).\n//  - On each rank, a CUDA kernel grows one candidate cluster per thread\n//    block; threads within a block cooperate on the argmin reduction and\n//    the distance updates over all unclustered points.\n//  - The globally best cluster (max cardinality, ties broken by lowest seed\n//    index, exactly as in the sequential code) is selected with an\n//    MPI_MAXLOC all-reduce. Its member list is then regenerated redundantly\n//    on every rank on the CPU using OpenMP, so no member data needs to be\n//    communicated.\n//  - Device code is compiled with -fmad=false and host code with\n//    -ffp-contract=off so CPU and GPU distances are bit-identical and the\n//    result matches the sequential algorithm exactly.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                            \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                       \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Sentinel marking a point that is already a member of the growing cluster\n// (or otherwise ineligible). Always >= any real distance and any threshold.\nstatic const double EXCLUDED = DBL_MAX;\n\nstatic const int TPB = 256;       // threads per block\nstatic const int MAX_GRID = 512;  // max concurrent candidate clusters per GPU\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block. Points are the compacted\n// (unclustered-only) set; coordinates in ux/uy. Block k handles compact seed\n// index firstSeed + k*seedStride (round-robin MPI distribution), grid-striding\n// over the rank's seeds. dist[j] tracks the max distance from point j to all\n// current cluster members; each step adds the point with minimal dist[j]\n// subject to dist[j] < threshold (ties -> lowest index), matching the\n// sequential algorithm. Only the resulting cardinality is stored.\n__global__ void candidateClusterKernel(const double* __restrict__ ux,\n                                       const double* __restrict__ uy,\n                                       const int U,\n                                       const double threshold,\n                                       const int firstSeed,\n                                       const int seedStride,\n                                       const int numLocalSeeds,\n                                       double* __restrict__ work,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[TPB];\n    __shared__ int sidx[TPB];\n    __shared__ double bestX, bestY;\n\n    double* dist = work + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * U;\n\n    for (int k = blockIdx.x; k < numLocalSeeds; k += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = firstSeed + k * seedStride;\n        const double sx = ux[seed];\n        const double sy = uy[seed];\n\n        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n            if (j == seed) {\n                dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n            } else {\n                const double dx = ux[j] - sx;\n                const double dy = uy[j] - sy;\n                dist[j] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        int count = 1;\n        while (count < U) {\n            // Block-wide argmin over eligible candidates\n            double bd = DBL_MAX;\n            int bi = INT_MAX;\n            for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d < threshold && d < bd) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = j;\n                }\n            }\n            sdist[threadIdx.x] = bd;\n            sidx[threadIdx.x] = bi;\n            __syncthreads();\n            for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n                if (threadIdx.x < s) {\n                    const double od = sdist[threadIdx.x + s];\n                    const int oi = sidx[threadIdx.x + s];\n                    if (od < sdist[threadIdx.x] ||\n                        (od == sdist[threadIdx.x] && oi < sidx[threadIdx.x])) {\n                        sdist[threadIdx.x] = od;\n                        sidx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                    }\n                }\n                __syncthreads();\n            }\n\n            const int best = sidx[0];\n            if (best == INT_MAX) break; j < U; j += blockDim.x) {\n                if (j == best) {\n                    dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d != EXCLUDED) {\n                    const double dx = ux[j] - bestX;\n                    const double dy = uy[j] - bestY;\n                    const double nd = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                    if (nd > d) dist[j] = nd;\n                }\n            }\n            ++count;\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            cards[k] = count;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Regenerate the winning cluster on the CPU (OpenMP-parallel greedy growth\n// over the compacted point set). Same selection rules as the CUDA kernel and\n// the original sequential code; returns members as original point indices.\nstatic std::vector<int> growClusterHost(const std::vector<double>& ux,\n                                        const std::vector<double>& uy,\n                                        const std::vector<int>& orig,\n                                        const int U,\n                                        const int seed,\n                                        const double threshold) {\n    std::vector<double> dist(U);\n    const double sx = ux[seed];\n    const double sy = uy[seed];\n\n    // For small working sets the OpenMP fork/join overhead per growth step\n    // outweighs the parallel work; run those serially.\n    const bool par = U >= 4096;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if(par)\n    for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n        if (j == seed) {\n            dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n        } else {\n            const double dx = ux[j] - sx;\n            const double dy = uy[j] - sy;\n            dist[j] = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.push_back(orig[seed]);\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < U) {\n        double bd = DBL_MAX;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        #pragma omp parallel if(par)\n        {\n            double lbd = DBL_MAX;\n            int lbi = INT_MAX;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n                const double d = dist[j];\n                if (d < threshold && d < lbd) {\n                    lbd = d;\n                    lbi = j;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lbd < bd || (lbd == bd && lbi < bi)) {\n                    bd = lbd;\n                    bi = lbi;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;\n\n        const double bx = ux[bi];\n        const double by = uy[bi];\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if(par)\n        for (int j = 0; j < U; ++j) {\n            if (j == bi) {\n                dist[j] = EXCLUDED;\n                continue;\n            }\n            const double d = dist[j];\n            if (d != EXCLUDED) {\n                const double dx = ux[j] - bx;\n                const double dy = uy[j] - by;\n                const double nd = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                if (nd > d) dist[j] = nd;\n            }\n        }\n\n        members.push_back(orig[bi]);\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int nprocs) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Compacted unclustered point set (rebuilt each round, ascending order)\n    std::vector<double> ux(N), uy(N);\n    std::vector<int> orig(N);\n\n    // Device buffers sized once for the worst case\n    double *d_ux = nullptr, *d_uy = nullptr, *d_work = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = nullptr;\n    const int maxLocalSeeds = (N + nprocs - 1) / nprocs;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ux, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_uy, sizeof(double) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_work, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(MAX_GRID) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_cards, sizeof(int) * std::max(maxLocalSeeds, 1)));\n    std::vector<int> h_cards(std::max(maxLocalSeeds, 1));\n\n    int remaining = N;\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // Compact the unclustered points (ascending original index)\n        int U = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            if (!clustered[i]) {\n                ux[U] = points[i].x;\n                uy[U] = points[i].y;\n                orig[U] = i;\n                ++U;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // This rank evaluates compact seeds rank, rank+nprocs, ...\n        const int numLocalSeeds = (rank < U) ? (U - rank + nprocs - 1) / nprocs : 0;\n\n        // Local best: max cardinality, ties -> lowest original seed index.\n        // Encoded as (cardinality, seed index) for MPI_MAXLOC, which picks the\n        // max value and the minimum index on ties - exactly the order in which\n        // the sequential code scans seeds.\n        int localBest[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};\n\n        if (numLocalSeeds > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_ux, ux.data(), sizeof(double) * U,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_uy, uy.data(), sizeof(double) * U,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n            const int grid = std::min(MAX_GRID, numLocalSeeds);\n            candidateClusterKernel<<<grid, TPB>>>(d_ux, d_uy, U, threshold,\n                                                  rank, nprocs, numLocalSeeds,\n                                                  d_work, d_cards);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_cards.data(), d_cards,\n                                  sizeof(int) * numLocalSeeds,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            // Compact seed indices are ascending, so the first maximum is the\n            // one with the lowest original seed index.\n            for (int k = 0; k < numLocalSeeds; ++k) {\n                if (h_cards[k] > localBest[0]) {\n                    localBest[0] = h_cards[k];\n                    localBest[1] = orig[rank + k * nprocs];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        int globalBest[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(localBest, globalBest, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (globalBest[0] <= 0) break;  // no more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Regenerate the winning cluster on every rank (deterministic)\n        const int bestSeed = globalBest[1];\n        const int compactSeed = static_cast<int>(\n            std::lower_bound(orig.begin(), orig.begin() + U, bestSeed) -\n            orig.begin());\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = bestSeed;\n        cluster.members = growClusterHost(ux, uy, orig, U, compactSeed, threshold);\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[cluster.members[i]] = true;\n        }\n        remaining -= static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size());\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_ux));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_uy));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_work));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_cards));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        #pragma omp parallel for reduction(max:max_diameter) schedule(dynamic)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1;  // establish context before timing\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, GPUs/node: %d, OpenMP threads: %d\\n\",\n               nprocs, deviceCount, omp_get_max_threads());\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, nprocs);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n        // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n        int total_clustered = 0;\n        int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n            const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n            total_clustered += size;\n            max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n        }\n\n        const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n            static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n        const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\",\n               clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n            std::vector<double> membershipData;\n            membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n            std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n            for (size_t c = 0; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CemnXEJqsqAMEpez3CvjH","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The QT clustering benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program that produces bit-identical results to the sequential original, with a ~270× speedup at n=1000 (7010 ms → 26 ms) and good multi-GPU scaling (3.3× from 1 to 4 GPUs at n=8000).\n\n**How it's parallelized.** Each round of QT clustering evaluates every unclustered point as a candidate seed, growing a greedy candidate cluster per seed — that seed loop is the O(N³)-ish hot spot and is embarrassingly parallel:\n\n- **MPI** distributes seeds round-robin across ranks (one GPU per rank via `rank % deviceCount`, so it scales across nodes too). The globally best cluster is chosen with a single `MPI_MAXLOC` all-reduce on (cardinality, seed index), which reproduces the sequential tie-breaking (highest cardinality, lowest seed index) exactly.\n- **CUDA** grows one candidate cluster per thread block: threads cooperate on a block-wide argmin reduction over candidate distances and on folding each new member into the running max-distance array. Only the compacted unclustered points are processed each round, and per-block scratch is reused via a grid-stride loop (512 blocks × 256 threads).\n- **OpenMP** parallelizes the host-side regeneration of the winning cluster's member list (done redundantly on every rank, so no member data crosses the network) and the validation diameter checks. Threads per rank auto-scale to `cores / node-local ranks` unless `OMP_NUM_THREADS` is set, avoiding oversubscription.\n\n**Correctness.** Device code is compiled with `-fmad=false` and host code with `-ffp-contract=off`, making GPU and CPU distance arithmetic bit-identical to the original. I rebuilt the original sequential code in /tmp as a reference: the `ClusterMembership` hash matches exactly for n = 35, 100, 500, 1000, 2000 across thresholds 0.5–5.0 and for 1, 2, 3, and 4 ranks, and `-v` validation passes everywhere. n=20000 (intractable sequentially) completes in 29 s on 4 GPUs with validation passing.\n\nTwo things worth knowing:\n- **Pre-existing quirk, not introduced by me:** `generateSyntheticData` infinite-loops for n below ~31 (group size `int(frand()·N/30)` is always 0). I confirmed the untouched original hangs identically at n=3, so I left that behavior alone for semantic equivalence.\n- `CMakeLists.txt` pins `g++-12` as the CUDA host compiler (nvcc 12.0 rejects the default gcc-13) and sets `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86`; both are overridable from the command line. Only the two existing files were modified, and the executable is still `qtclustering` (runs standalone or under `mpirun`)."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":349,"cache_read_input_tokens":60645,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":349},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f761022b-77bb-4505-b408-225d23e7fc72","uuid":"62b2ffc9-48ed-4215-97fe-1d61187a9e60","timestamp":"2026-09-06T07:24:18.881Z","request_id":"req_011CemnXCgcMKs3aZoj934hB"}
